release_notes:
v1.0.31+38 - Public Catalog Category Sync & Video Tutorial Expiry Indication
- Harmonized Storefront Category Matching: Unified _itemMatchesCategory across Public Catalog tabs, counts, and curated carousels; E-Books & PDFs count accurately reflects all database items (E-Books, Digital Editions, PDF Books) instead of showing 0.
- Honest Video Tutorial Expiry Indication: Video tutorials and time passes are strictly decoupled from permanent digital store items. Tutorials display "ACTIVE PASS" and "Stream" strictly when an active pass exists, and revert honestly to "KES 10 / hr" and "Get Pass" immediately upon pass expiration.
- Auto-Purged Polluted Store Keys: Sanitized device purchase cache in SharedPreferences, preventing expired micro-passes from permanently caching as unlocked materials.
